page_title: WOL 2-3 RBL | Wolfsburg v RB Leipzig 11/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+2' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Kamil Grabara!
90+2' Florian Exner interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolfsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. There is a free kick near the sideline to RB Leipzig.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Kamil Grabara anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target. RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
88' RB Leipzig force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' RB Leipzig fail to score from a corner as Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
86' It will be a substitution. Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Bence Dardai walks off.
86' Substitution. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) replaces Patrick Wimmer.
86' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
85' Substitution. Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) on for Xavi Simons.
84' The attendance for today's match is 25000.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.

83' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is saved by Peter Gulacsi. It will be a corner kick for Wolfsburg.
81' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
80' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
77' Here is a change. Kosta Nedeljkovic is going off and Zsolt Low gives the last tactical orders to Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig).
77' Today's match ends for Lois Openda who will be replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
76' It's like he was asking for a caution. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card.
75' 2 - 3 Goal! Joakim Maehle shows great vision to find Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the top left corner. 2:3.
74' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
73' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
73' Florian Exner blows his whistle after Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Wolfsburg get a free kick.
71' Zsolt Low decides to make a substitution. Arthur Vermeeren will be replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
71' The substitution is prepared. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ridle Baku.
71' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Denis Vavro and he is replaced by Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) replaces Jakub Kaminski.
70' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Peter Gulacsi makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
70' A corner kick by Wolfsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig).
68' David Odogu (Wolfsburg) is adjudged offside.
67' The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) trips an opposition player and Florian Exner signals a foul. A free kick to RB Leipzig.
63' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
61' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

61' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
60' It must be a yellow card. It is. Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
58' 1 - 3 What a beauty from just outside the box! Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the left post.
58' Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Florian Exner blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
55' Now Wolfsburg have a corner.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg. Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
54' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Wolfsburg earn a corner.

53' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Peter Gulacsi shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
49' 0 - 3 Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
46' Referee Florian Exner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Florian Exner blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
45+1' Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) smashes the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after going way off target.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
39' Florian Exner blows the whistle, Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul.
38' POST! Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
36' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Florian Exner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
34' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
33' Wolfsburg fail to score from a corner as Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig) leaps to collect the ball.
30' Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Florian Exner stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
29' The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

26' 0 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Kamil Grabara just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:2.
22' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
22' Celebrations are cut short for RB Leipzig as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
22' The RB Leipzig players halt their celebrations as referee Florian Exner makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
20' Goal! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 0:1.
20' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' A player from Wolfsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
14' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

11' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball sits up nicely for Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) and he hits a crackerjack of a strike past the goalkeeper. It ricochets off the bottom of the left post into the back of the net. This could be the goal of the month.
7' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
5' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! RB Leipzig will take the kick-off.
Florian Exner is the one to supervise the game today.
